title: fastify
tagline: Fast and low overhead web framework, for Node.js.

why.title: Built for throughput
why.body: Designed around low overhead so a server spends its time on your code, not the framework.

why.title: Everything is a plugin
why.body: Routes, hooks and decorators are encapsulated plugins you can compose and share.

why.title: Validate + serialize fast
why.body: JSON Schema validates input and compiles output serializers for speed.

architecture.heading: Architecture
architecture.summary: Lifecycle hooks wrap every request, and schemas make validation and serialization fast.

numbersNote: Sample deck made with Carbon from github.com/fastify/fastify.
